description: We are a passionate team from Shivamogga building an interactive Martian map and survival guide for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary:
Mars Navigator AI: An Interactive Mars Exploration, Geological Mapping and Mission Planning System is a web-based platform designed to make Mars exploration more interactive, visual and informative. It combines NASA and USGS resources to help users explore the Martian surface, understand its geological features and study previous rover missions.

The platform provides an interactive 3D Mars globe, geological maps, rover exploration history, Perseverance raw images, terrain visualization and scientific discoveries, with a special focus on Jezero Crater. It also includes route planning, potential hazard visualization and mission planning tools to demonstrate how robotic and future human exploration could be planned.

The project uses resources such as NASA Mars Trek, USGS planetary geological maps, NASA's Curiosity route reference, NASA Worldview and the Perseverance Raw Images Gallery. Through interactive maps, charts, visual dashboards and data exploration, Mars Navigator AI aims to make planetary science easier to understand and explore.

The main objective is to create an educational and scientific exploration platform that connects authentic planetary data with modern visualization and planning technologies, encouraging interest in Mars research and future space exploration.
details: Mars Navigator AI is an interactive planetary exploration and mission-planning platform that uses NASA and USGS resources to explore the surface of Mars. It combines 3D Mars visualization, geological maps, rover exploration history, scientific images and terrain analysis to help users understand Martian geography and discoveries. The platform focuses on Jezero Crater and provides features such as geological mapping, potential hazard identification, and intelligent route planning using the A* algorithm. It also includes a mission dashboard with exploration statistics and hypothetical astronaut mission-planning calculations. By bringing scientific information together through interactive maps, visualizations and dashboards, the project aims to make Mars exploration easier to understand and more engaging for students, researchers and space enthusiasts.
